lines: Me
「Kuh!! Everyone through that door!!!」
The door was closed behind us and locked tight, making a dull thud.
The place was a dingy, run-down bar, apparently before opening time.
The person who had beckoned us in was standing in a corner of the gloom.
「Long time no see, eh, Taimanin?」
Una
「Hyeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeh?!!! A bea—A beeeast!!!」
Mai
「A beastman......?!」
Mari
「Whoa, whoa?! I can't see in front of me! Don't latch onto me, Una-chan～!」
Perhaps because she harboured the powers of a rabbit, she seemed to have a problem with beasts.
Una had shivered, and sproinged over to throw her arms around Mari's face.
Me
「No, it's all right, Una. This person――or rather, this werewolf is a friend of mine.」
Una
「Really?!!」
I had remembered as soon as I heard his voice just now.
The were-form of the gang leader I had gotten to know previously through the CD gas incident.
We had met once or twice after that as well, and he had also saved Kirara-senpai when she was about to be led away by incubi.
Werewolf
「Oops. Pardon this――」
Gang Leader
「Sorry for that, little ladies.」
Gang Leader
「I'd taken animal form 'cause I thought some dirty business was coming up, but looks like it was a little too much of a shock for you guys.」
Seeing the reactions of Una and the others, the werewolf undid his beast transformation.
He had the look of an animal, but it seemed that he was a surprising gentleman on the inside.
Una
「Huh......?! You're not a scary beast......?」
Mai
「Where beastmen are concerned, you can't beat the Wolf Guy series. It was all kinds of extreme.」
Mari
「Hawawah...... My glasses slipped off because of Una-chan's hand...... Glasses, glasses......」
It looked like Una had also finally regained her composure, and the chaos of the beastman's entrance had settled down (apart from one person looking for her glasses).
For now, I quickly introduced the three of them to the werewolf.
How I had made his acquaintance during an incident that occurred in this underworld city before.
How he was part of a gang, but he was surprisingly soft-hearted, and not a bad guy.

And then―perhaps because it was rare to have the chance to chat familiarly with a dweller of the underworld―the three of them suddenly changed their attitudes, and seemed very interested in the wolfman.
Mari
「Th-That's amazing!! So Fuuma-san is even friends with a beastman! I'm impressed!!」
Una
「You're not a scary animal, right?! Then, let's be friends! I'm Mochizuki Una! Nice to meet yooouuu!」
Mai
「According to Mutsu Gorou-san's writing, to tame a werewolf, you look down at it authoritatively, like this, and――Shake, boy!」
Gang Leader
「Arf. ――N-No, stop it! Don't come near me! I'm not interested in any other woman but Hebiko-san!!」
The werewolf, who was surprisingly inexperienced with women, had become flustered, surrounded by the three girls.
Me
（Come to think of it, this wolfman was taken with Hebiko, wasn't he......?）
He seemed to think of Hebiko, who was an octopus Beast Escape user, as a fellow half-animal, half-human.
Una, who was right here, was likewise a Beast Escape user, but since she only made her ears bestial, maybe that wasn't enough for him.
Me

「Now, everyone, let me talk first.
――Thanks for before. You saved us from a tight spot.」
Gang Leader
「Y-Yeah. Sure thing...... I didn't really do anything major...」
Me
「Not at all. The way things were going, that was going to get dicey for us.」
That said, there was one aspect that I was curious about. Why did he, a dweller of the underworld, go out of his way to save us?
However, before I could inquire that,
Trolls
「Grrr...... Guoooohhh......」
Una
「Huwaah?!! Wh-What's that noise?!」
Mai
「A nearby building...... I suppose?」
Me
「That must mean―the guys chasing us are searching through houses systematically.」
Through the thin walls, I could hear the sounds of a crowd breaking into the neighbouring building.
It looked like we couldn't call this place safe either.
Gang Leader
「Tch!! We can't buy much time here, huh......?」
Gang Leader
「There's an escape route this way!! Follow me, Taimanin. I'll explain while we run!!」
